newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Cash basis moves higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Cash basis moves higher.

text.p: Cash soymeal basis values were higher at several locations in reaction to news and market talk that soybean processors will be scaling back operations because of poor operating margins, dealers said.
Several dealers said the higher basis and CBOT soymeal futures may price soymeal out of feed rations.

Archer Daniels Midland Co said Wednesday it will close its Clarksdale, Miss., soybean processing plant until September 1, and will reduce production at three other plants. Also, dealers said several other processing companies should be scaling back production this week or next.
Also, Cargill Inc last week said it was temporarily closing its Kansas City and Norfolk, Va., soy crushing plants this spring.
Estimates for the National Oilseed Processors Assn weekly crush to be released late Thursday ranged from 28.5 million to 29.8 million bushels versus 30.106 million a week ago.
